title: Moved VDBE B-tree cursor restoration

scope.rationale: sqlite3VdbeHandleMovedCursor restores a moved native B-tree cursor, always invalidates its cached row state, marks the VDBE cursor as a null row when restoration reports a different record, and returns the exact B-tree result.

dependencies.caller_closure: The complete moved-cursor state update is assigned behind a typed restore seam; cursor-restore dispatch remains open.

inputs: Native VdbeCursor of B-tree type with non-null moved BtCursor
outputs: Exact restore result, stale cache status, and nullRow when the restored row differs
contracts.ownership: All cursor pointers are borrowed; no allocation or ownership transfer.
contracts.state_and_results: cacheStatus becomes CACHE_STALE regardless of restore result; nonzero isDifferentRow sets nullRow without clearing an existing nullRow otherwise.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: B-tree restore seam owns required cursor locking and pager I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Restore errors pass through after cache invalidation and source-defined different-row publication.

representation_differences: A typed restore function seam represents sqlite3BtreeCursorRestore until native BtCursor behavior is connected to this layout owner.
The existing src/core/vdbe.zig Cursor-union helper remains a separate integrated runtime owner; this declaration supplies exact native VdbeCursor field behavior.

oracle.protocol: Restore a native-layout VdbeCursor through a deterministic seam returning an error and different-row marker, then compare exact result, cacheStatus, and nullRow.
oracle.normalization: Opaque BtCursor address is identity-only; all scalar fields and result codes are exact. Pinned-C trace remains pending.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Restore I/O and locking belong to the B-tree seam.
assurance.malformed_input: Non-B-tree, null, or not-moved cursors violate source assertions.
assurance.continuation: Caller receives the exact restore result with stale cache and any null-row transition published.
assurance.performance: One B-tree restore plus constant-time state updates.

integration.native_call_path: The native-layout owner is compile- and unit-traced; opcode cursor dispatch remains on the separate Cursor-union owner.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No; src/core/vdbe.zig remains the current runtime path.

independent_review.notes: Requires native cursor dispatch, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.
